name: suggestion
description: A change suggested to someone's writing and not made, shown as writing: why, then the sentence as it is now and as it would read, formatted, with the part that changes highlighted, and Accept and Decline. A change to the formatting alone is said in words. Shown on the page of what it is about.

use.when: the assistant or an agent suggests a change to words a person wrote, rather than making it.
use.not: a change to the canvas or a setting, which is a proposal; or words the assistant is writing for itself.
use.with: the record it is about, above its fields; one per change, each answered on its own.

label.description: Which it is among those waiting, such as 2 of 5: it names the group with why, and makes each Accept and Decline its own.

meaning.description: It changes what is said, not only how, and says so.

describe.description: The change in words, when words say it better than the text can: Make it bold, Make it a heading.

now.description: The writing around the change as it is now, as Markdown; it is shown formatted.

nowMark.description: The passage within now that would change, highlighted.

after.description: The same writing with the change made; empty when the change takes it all out.

afterMark.description: What came in, within after, highlighted.

outdated.description: The words it would change are no longer there: it says so and offers only to set it aside.

actor.description: Who suggested it, for its colour.

from.description: The page it is answered from, to come back to.

wcag.notes: A group named by its place among those waiting and why, so moving to Accept says which (1.3.1). The writing is shown formatted as it reads, never as markup; the changed part is highlighted with an outline as well as colour (1.4.1) and named for a screen reader. Nothing changes until a button is pressed (3.2.5).

machine.identify: A group whose accessible name is its place and why. The highlighted mark in Now is what would change; in With the change, what comes in.
machine.operate: Post to Accept or Decline. Nothing changes until you do; an outdated one only sets aside.
